title: Wow I just discovered this mall world phenomenon. I had dreamed of this 4 times in the past 7 years.
content: The entrance is a subway station. Massive 5-7 floor structure. Tons of people but they don't seem to interact with each other. Just going their own ways yet I hear lots of chatter. I always visit this store that sells vinyl records and action figures (I'm not a collector). Every time I dream, my time at this place gets extended. 2nd dream I look for my mother at a clothing store with glass as walls. 3rd time is a pillow store with neon lights. It's very cozy here, I'd set up some giant pillows on the floor and id lie down. The last dream was I was suppose to meet some friends at the food court but the place is empty. I want to go back
